about_the_game:
UK joins the WWA battlefield and gives you a chance to be among the first players to try it out! This DLC contains everything you need to have a competitive British deck and start climbing the ranks in World War Armies!

This pack includes the following UK units:

  • 1x Vickers Crossley"Winter" Skin

  • 1x A10 Cruiser Mk2 "Winter" Skin

  • 1x Churchill Mk4 "Winter" Skin

  • 1x A27M Cromwell "Winter" Skin

  • 1x Royal Engineer card

  • 3x PIAT cards

  • 3x A27M Cromwell cards

  • 5x Archer MK1 cards

  • 10x British Rifleman cards

  • 10x Vickers Crossley cards

  • 20x Lewis Gun cards

  • 20x A10 Cruiser Mk2 cards

  • 20x Churchill Mk4 cards

  • 500 Tokens

  • 10000 Coins

short_description: Dive into a gripping cross-platform real-time strategy experience, navigating through a turbulent gaming landscape. Command advanced war machines, outsmart your foes, and forge your legacy in the gaming world.
